Ibne muljim ne zarbath lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

(1) aaj haider ke ghar me ye matam

aaj jibreel rote khade hai

ibne muljim ne zarbaath lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

(2) mahe ramzan vonnis ko mara

azadaro ye kaisa ye din hai

ibne muljim ne zarbaath lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

(3) zainab-o-kulsoom hasnain sabi bhi

haye wo bache yateem hogaye hai

ibne muljim ne zarbaath lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

(4) aaj kufe me kohraam macha hai

khoon me dooba shere khuda

ibne muljim ne zarbaath lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

(5) mere mushkil khusha mere moula

apko zarb kitna laga hai

ibne muljim ne zarbaat lagaya

aaj haider ki rukhsat ghadi hai

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re

path = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/ibne-muljim-ne-zarbaath-lagaya-nw-2f6ebe059f4f.md\")
_, metadata, body = path.read_text().split(\"---\", 2)
roman = []
for line in body.splitlines():
    if not line.strip():
        continue
    stanza = re.match(r\""'^'"\\((\\d+)\\) (.+)"'$", line)
    if stanza:
        roman.extend(["", stanza[1]])
        line = stanza[2]
    line = line[0].upper() + line[1:]
    for name in ("muljim", "haider", "jibreel", "ramzan", "zainab", "kulsoom", "hasnain", "kufe", "khuda"):
        line = re.sub(rf"'"\\b{name}\\b\", name.capitalize(), line)
    roman.append(line)

opening = [\"ابنِ ملجم نے ضربت لگایا\", \"آج حیدر کی رخصت گھڑی ہے\"]
stanzas = [
    [\"آج حیدر کے گھر میں یہ ماتم\", \"آج جبرئیل روتے کھڑے ہیں\"],
    [\"ماہِ رمضان انیس کو مارا\", \"عزادارو یہ کیسا یہ دن ہے\"],
    [\"زینب و کلثوم حسنین سبھی بھی\", \"ہائے وہ بچے یتیم ہو گئے ہیں\"],
    [\"آج کوفے میں کہرام مچا ہے\", \"خون میں ڈوبا شیرِ خدا\"],
    [\"میرے مشکل کشا میرے مولا\", \"آپ کو ضرب کتنا لگا ہے\"],
]
source = opening.copy()
for number, stanza in zip(\"۱۲۳۴۵\", stanzas):
    source.extend([\"\", number, *stanza, *opening])

assert len(roman) == len(source)
for original, verse in zip(roman, source):
    assert bool(original) == bool(verse)
    if original.isdecimal():
        assert int(original) == int(verse)
    else:
        assert not verse.isdecimal()

metadata = metadata.replace('title: \"IBNE MULJIM NE ZARBAATH LAGAYA\"', 'title: \"ابنِ ملجم نے ضربت لگایا\"\\nalternateTitle: \"Ibne Muljim Ne Zarbaath Lagaya\"')
metadata = metadata.replace('direction: \"ltr\"', 'direction: \"rtl\"').replace('tags: [\"noUrdu\"]', 'tags: []')
path.write_text(\"---\" + metadata + \"romanLyrics: |-\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(f\"  {line}\" if line else \"\" for line in roman) + \"\\n---\\n\\n\" + \"\\n\".join(source) + \"\\n\")
PY

item.text:
Reconstructed the Urdu-script [lyric](/home/ghayur/.local/state/kalam-codex-round2/shards/1/workspaces/edffce231be84f528729d69eb144dba3/src/data/lyrics/ibne-muljim-ne-zarbaath-lagaya-nw-2f6ebe059f4f.md) and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Both editions have the same two-line opening and five numbered stanzas, with 22 verses each. Updated the titles and right-to-left direction, and removed the `noUrdu` tag.

I read the ambiguous `vonnis` in stanza 2 as `انیس` (nineteen) and kept `vonnis` in the Roman text.
